reason: A Windows DeepSeek Harness plugin that uses Git for Windows Bash as the command executor while integrating with the harness permission modes and terminal display.

summaries.zh: 在 Windows 上为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Git for Windows Bash 执行器，并保留其受限与完全访问权限模式。
summaries.en: Provides Git for Windows Bash as the DeepSeek Harness command executor on Windows while retaining its restricted and full-access permission modes.

capabilities: Replaces PowerShell with Git for Windows Bash as the DeepSeek Harness command executor on Windows
Runs foreground, background, Web Agent, and nested Bash commands
Supports read-only, workspace-write, and danger-full-access execution modes
Includes a native Windows token guard for restricted execution modes
Allows configuring and selecting the bash.exe executable path
